SELECT s.slide_id, i.image_name AS slide_name, p.project_id, p.project_name, g.group_id, g.group_name, t.topic_id, t.topic_name, r.round_id, r.round_name FROM tb_slide AS s LEFT JOIN tb_project AS p ON s.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN tb_group AS g ON g.group_id = s.group_id LEFT JOIN tb_topic AS t ON t.topic_id = s.topic_id LEFT JOIN tb_round AS r ON r.round_id = s.round_id LEFT JOIN tb_image AS i ON i.image_id = s.image_id
AND s.slide_id = #{slideId}
